meta.description: With the full stack on (filter→LNA + nulling + excision + cyclostationary + SEI, memory=fade, multi-angle) on the modern threat world, how much does the receiver still matter? bladeRF 2-ch vs coherent array 5-ch vs fused. 40 maps × 3 altitudes.
